## Goal
ROADMAP 3.3 "Legal escalation pack: complaint to the state AG / CPPA prefilled when a broker ignores a lawful request" (0.4). Today the last rung is a to-do with links only (`engine/runner.py:957-970`). Add `complaint_pack_vars(profile, broker, listings, state_law, sent, *, today=None) -> dict` to `letters.py`: the same data-minimized variables as `letter_vars` (`letters.py:127-`, name only unless a listing shows more) plus a dated timeline of what was sent, built from a small frozen `SentLetter(kind, sent_on, reference)` input so the helper never touches a store. It returns `timeline` (list of `{"kind", "date", "reference"}` sorted by date), `first_request_date`, `days_waiting` (whole days from the first request to `today`), the verified `response_deadline` only when `state_law` is the result of `outbox.effective_law` with a verified window (same rule as `letters.py:176-186`), `complaint_urls`, and the verified `citation`. No template is rendered; a template needs an in-house file (see the E3 in-house to-do in EPICS.md).

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
1. For a fake profile and three `SentLetter` rows (opt_out, follow_up, legal_demand) the timeline is sorted by date, kinds are the `RequestKind` values, and `days_waiting` counts from the first request.
2. With `state_law=None` there is no `citation`, no `response_deadline` and no statute name; `complaint_urls` is an empty list (the caller decides the fallback).
3. With a law whose window is not verified (`response_days=None` after `effective_law`), no deadline appears; with a verified window the deadline equals first request date plus `response_days`.
4. Data minimization: with a listing that shows only the name, the result has no city, state, age, phone, street or zip (same assertions as `letter_vars` tests); the removal mailbox is included.
5. Hostile values (CR/LF, `{{ 7*7 }}`) in the profile or reference come back unchanged as data (no evaluation) and CR/LF are normalised the same way WO-241 does for letters.
6. Empty `sent` returns an empty timeline and `days_waiting` None; nothing raises.
7. `letter_vars` and every existing letter test pass unchanged.

This is Codex code-lane work (owner, 2026-11-09): fix and improve the listed module(s) directly, with tests; don't xfail a bug you can fix here. No contract changes: public function signatures, `src/freemyid/models.py`, `interfaces.py`, schema files, `--json` shapes and documented CLI output stay as they are (additive helpers inside the listed files are fine). If the work turns out to need a contract change, stop and say so in VENDOR_STATUS.md "Questions for the owner". Fake data only, offline (fake fetchers, no network), Windows-safe paths in tests (`tmp_path`, `pathlib`, no `/tmp`). Typed, ruff-clean, small diff. Line numbers are from main at the time of writing (2026-11-09); re-check them.
